The acoustic BGM remains at a moderate volume, balanced well below the vocals to ensure clarity. There is minimal ambient noise, suggesting a quiet indoor recording environment with a high signal-to-noise ratio. The underlying acoustic music maintains its gentle, melodic texture without significant shifts in tempo or instrumentation, reinforcing the sleepy mood. Occasional soft sounds of fabric movement or rustling are detected alongside the vocals. (4) The primary vocals and BGM fade out, replaced by a short, bright synthesized stinger or brand jingle. This sound effect has a high spectral centroid and serves as a definitive acoustic punctuation mark for the end of the video, matching the visual logo screen.
